_comment: Signing-certificate pins for the untouched vendor APKs. scripts/verify-vendor-apks.sh runs apksigner verify --print-certs on every APK in vendor/<app>/ and compares the first certificate digest against these values. An empty pin prints the observed certificate and skips the check. Read the values with: apksigner verify --print-certs vendor/<app>/<apk>

com.nothing.smartcenter._comment: Confirmed on 3.8.0: the certificate the workflow observed on every split matches the digests APKMirror and APKPure report for the 3.8.0 bundle. The pin now gates future fetches.
